attributes.description:
Learn Rust, then make it run. Crabrix brings Rust to iPhone and iPad. The Rust compiler ships in the app: no cloud compiler or app account is required.

ACADEMY, AVAILABLE OFFLINE
Seven courses cover Rust, Cargo, interviews and 200 algorithm patterns. Study 798 lessons and steps with highlighted code, questions and illustrations. Download courses, then study offline. Optional signed Atlas sections play 400 source-bound recordings: inspect state, step and scrub. Edit a personal copy and use local Run/Debug; recordings keep their original source. Updates preserve progress and projects. Explore 46 open code examples.

PROJECT WORKSPACE
Files, syntax highlighting, search, Code, Problems, Output and Terminal. Check finds compiler errors; Build compiles without running main; Run executes locally in a bounded WebAssembly sandbox. Read output and build stages. iPad has a sidebar; Duo adapts to its fold.

GIT TO DELIVERY
24 lessons connect Git, CLI, HTTP, SQL, diagnostics and delivery. Typed labs execute Rust and SQLite. Task Ledger shares CLI/HTTP/SQL data. Terminal adds argv/env/stdin, curl/.http and Shell/SQL/HTTP/Dockerfile/diff/.env highlighting. Docker/CI use the desktop profile.

NATIVE GIT
Record commits, inspect diffs/history, preview Restore and switch clean branches. Clone GitHub over HTTPS, fetch, pull clean fast-forwards and explicitly push committed history. Private access uses device-only repository Keychain. Complete .crabrixrepo copies preserve commit IDs, branches and worktree bytes, including binary files. Tokens and package caches stay outside exports.

RUST TOOLS ON DEVICE
Prepare up to 2,048 checksummed Cargo packages for offline builds. Standard-library-only build scripts run as bounded WASI guests. The target is wasm32-wasip1; native linking, host subprocesses, separate build-dependency graphs and external procedural macros remain unsupported. Files preflight separates exact-source Check/Build/Run/Debug evidence. Review Cargo feature diffs; the original manifest is retained.

Run selected-entry unit tests with discovery, filtering, isolated failures and Stop. Dev-dependencies, integration targets and doctests are outside this test profile. Format Rust files/projects with bundled rustfmt, check formatting and undo changes.

LOCAL SOURCE DEBUGGER
Set breakpoints, step through Rust and active async functions, and inspect frames, String, Vec and concrete struct previews. Const bodies, macro internals and arbitrary memory inspection remain outside scope.

BROWSER PROJECTS
Create HTML/CSS/JavaScript pages or generate them with Rust. Explicit npm install/ci prepares supported browser modules and licenses. Bundled TypeScript checks TS/TSX with ES/DOM and prepared package declarations. Problems opens the source location. Run independently bundles/previews in WebKit. Check/Run never download types. No Node/Bun servers, arbitrary scripts, plugins or native addons.

TEMPORARY PLAYGROUNDS
Share encrypted source with another Crabrix app or the free browser Playground. Live cursors/selections, no login. One hour by default; 24 hours maximum. The relay holds ciphertext in RAM; restart can end a room early. Save before expiry. Four participants, 16 text files, 64 KiB/file and 128 KiB total; packages/images are not shared. Each client runs code locally and explicitly. An optional desktop MCP bridge edits source and selections. Allow local Check/Build/Run/Debug on one chosen client in Share, with revocable permission. Others only receive reported output. Shared execution uses std/local modules.

Practice stays local: Quick Practice, Term Train, Code Recall and lesson Flashcards. Learning backup is optional in private iCloud or Files; projects and credentials are excluded. Five themes, optional Face ID/passcode. No ads or analytics SDK. Privacy, Terms and licenses are available offline. One purchase; no subscription or in-app purchase.
attributes.whatsNew:
24 new lessons connect Git → CLI → HTTP API → SQL → diagnostics → delivery, with worked programs, independent typed labs and boundary checks.

Open Task Ledger and practise with shared CLI/HTTP/SQLite data. Terminal adds argv/env/stdin, SQL, curl and HTTP request files, plus matching syntax highlighting.

Download or update Cargo & Real Projects to Projects 1.1.0. Existing course progress, projects, Flashcards and Atlas recordings are retained.

Updated the bundled Rust compiler and standard library to fix narrow atomic operations. Supported procedural macros now run locally, including Serde derive.
